text:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Paging SRE + runtime on-call for NimbusInc (dedicated pool) — customer reports missing spans and absent log access for tenant nimbus-47. Severity: p1 until we confirm observability for their traffic.
Mira Chen: saw the alert, linking their customer ticket: https://zendesk.example/tickets/NI-4782 — CS says they're seeing 0 traces and sporadic metric shards.
Jordan Patel: oncall here, grabbing context. Are metrics missing or just traces?
Hana Park: CS update: metrics show ingestion, but per-tenant dashboards for nimbus-47 show null series for p50/p95 and logs page returns 403 for some keys.
Sasha Lee: :thinking_face: sounds like a per-tenant forwarder role or the trace-forwarder routing table is missing the tenant mapping. Could be the dedicated forwarder proxy that handles tenant lookup.
Kevin O'Connor: I can check the dedicated pool control-plane. Quick checks: 1) forwarder pods healthy? 2) IAM role bindings for tenant forwarding? 3) metric partitions for the tenant active?
Alex Rivera: I'll jump on runtime to verify KV cache routing and whether we dropped tenant header. If the request path lost x-tenant-id header downstream traces will be orphaned.
Mira Chen: Customer impact: NimbusInc staging is 80% of their traffic on this pool. Production shows gaps too but less pronounced. They want ETA and workaround.
Jordan Patel: Running quick kubectl into namespace nimbus-dedicated-prod: pods show 3/3 forwarder instances Ready. Logs show repeated 403s when fetching KMS-wrapped keys for tenant-prefixed forwarder: `permission denied: decrypt`
Sasha Lee: That matches CS 403. Maybe the forwarder service account lost KMS decrypt permission during last role rotation. Anyone touch IAM?
Kevin O'Connor: Ops-bot: show last IAM changes for role r-forwarder-nimbus
Ops-bot: last change 2026-01-31T03:12Z by infra-rotations — rotated key version to v5, granted decrypt to service-account:forwarder-nimbus? NO — grant missing.
Mira Chen: Ok that would explain missing logs/traces (forwarder can't decrypt tenant envelope to route). Proposed mitigation: temporarily enable a proxy that uses cached tenant mapping and bypasses KMS decrypt for reads, then restore proper KMS binding. Can we do that without downtime?
Alex Rivera: We have a read-only cached mapping in S3 from yesterday with tenant routing table. I can flip a feature flag to use cache-first routing in forwarder. Patch would be quick: `kubectl set env deployment/forwarder -n nimbus-dedicated USE_CACHE_ROUTING=true`
Jordan Patel: If we do that, we should confirm it's safe (read-only) and won't reintroduce stale routing for recently onboarded tenants. For NimbusInc they haven't onboarded new prefixes in last 24h so safe for mitigation.
Sasha Lee: Also need a temporary log access path for CS so they can view logs while we fix KMS. Suggest providing a signed URL to a streamed S3 export of the last 6h logs for tenant nimbus-47.
Hana Park: CS can share the signed S3 link to NimbusInc support contact. They asked for timeframe, need ETA.
Kevin O'Connor: I can add the IAM decrypt permission to the forwarder role now. Quick IRL check: IAM binding command:
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/tenant-keys/cryptoKeys/nimbus --member=serviceAccount:forwarder-nimbus@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```
But need approval from infra rotations owner.
Mira Chen: Who can approve immediately? Jordan, can you escalate to infra rotations oncall?
Jordan Patel: Paging infra-rotations oncall @InfraOps: urgent approval to add KMS decrypt to forwarder-nimbus service account for immediate mitigation. :phone:
PagerDuty Bot: Escalation sent to oncall rotation infra-rotations (primary: Priya Rao). ETA for response ~9m.
Priya Rao (via infra-rotations, joined thread): Oncall infra, I see the request. We can approve but want to verify key audit entries. Kevin, can you provide the principal and exact permission?
Kevin O'Connor: principal: `serviceAccount:forwarder-nimbus@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com`, role: `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` — command as pasted above.
Priya Rao: Approving now. Applying and monitoring.
Ops-bot: IAM binding applied at 2499123468 by infra-rotations. Audit log id: audit-8492.
Sasha Lee: Once applied we should validate by tailing forwarder logs for successful decrypts: `kubectl logs -f deployment/forwarder -n nimbus-dedicated | grep "decrypt ok"`
Alex Rivera: I'm toggling the cache flag while Kevin applies the IAM change as a belt-and-suspenders mitigation.
```
kubectl set env deployment/forwarder -n nimbus-dedicated USE_CACHE_ROUTING=true
```
Applying now (will roll 1 pod at a time).
Mira Chen: CS to NimbusInc: temporary steps in place to restore log/traces access within 10-15m, we're applying IAM fix + cache fallback. Will share signed log export if you need interim access.
Hana Park: Customer contact responded: please share logs, they'll validate traces reappearing.
Kevin O'Connor: IAM change applied. Observing forwarder logs: `decrypt ok` entries starting at 2499123472. Tracing pipeline reports restored span IDs for tenant nimbus-47.
Sasha Lee: Confirmed in tracing UI: p50/p95 series repopulating for nimbus-47 from 2499123473. Logs page loads for previously 403 keys.
Jordan Patel: Good. Can we keep cache routing enabled until next maintenance window? I'd rather remove once KMS rotation audit completed, but keeping it for 12h with plan to revert.
Priya Rao: We'll schedule a rotation audit at 02:00Z and confirm everything is stable. Leave cache flag for now.
Mira Chen: Final notes for postmortem: root cause = IAM binding omitted during KMS key rotation for tenant forwarder principal. Impact = missing traces/logs/metrics for tenant nimbus-47; mitigation = reapply IAM decrypt role + cache-first routing fallback + provide S3 log export. Next steps: owner infra-rotations to update rotation playbook to validate principal grants, runtime to add a healthcheck for decrypt failures that triggers alert.
Alex Rivera: I'll add the decrypt failure healthcheck and a dashboard alert.
Hana Park: I'll log the customer comms and mark ticket NI-4782 as mitigation-in-place.
Mira Chen: Thanks team. Marking thread resolved after 2499123490. :white_check_mark:
